title: Microblading
summary: Individual hair strokes drawn into the skin, one by one, to follow the way your own brow grows.

title: Microblading + Shading
summary: Hair strokes at the front, soft shading through the body and tail. Fuller than microblading alone, still natural.

title: Ombre Powder Brows
summary: A soft powdered finish, lighter at the front and deeper at the tail, like a well-blended brow pencil.

title: Eyeliner
summary: A fine line along the lash line that stays put through swimming, sleep, and sweat.

title: Lash Enhancement
summary: Pigment placed between the lashes only. Lashes look fuller; nobody sees a line.

title: Lip Tint
summary: Evens lip tone and gives back the color that fades with time. Your lips, a shade warmer.

title: Scalp Micropigmentation
summary: Tiny pigment dots that read as closely shaved hair, filling thinning areas and hairlines.

title: Yearly touch-up
summary: A color refresh once a year keeps healed work crisp.

title: Additional touch-up
summary: Any extra perfecting session beyond the included one.

title: Tattoo removal
summary: Lightens old or unwanted permanent makeup before correcting it.
